script:
---level46 script---

local isPlayingDemo = false
local countFail = 0
local isSkip = true
local hasViewedStory = global.getBool("lvl46_b1")

if not hasViewedStory or not game.isRestart() then
	repeat
		if hasViewedStory then dialog.setSkipEnabled(true) end
		game.setUserInputEnabled(false)
		role.setIdleActionEnabled(false)
		script.delay(1)
		if dialog.show("Level46-1", faceWeixiao) ==1 then break end
		sound.play("46-1");
		camera.setFollowRoleMode(false)
		camera.gotoPosition(416,368)
		if dialog.show("Level46-2", faceJingya) ==1 then break end
		sound.play("60-1");
		if dialog.show("Level46-3", faceWunai) ==1 then break end
		sound.play("43-1");
		if dialog.show("Level46-4", faceRenzhen) ==1 then break end
		sound.play("54-1");
		if dialog.show("Level46-5", faceDeyi) ==1 then break end
		camera.gotoRole()
		if dialog.show("Level46-6", faceManyi) ==1 then break end
		camera.setFollowRoleMode(true)
		
		--set story viewed flag
        global.setBool("lvl46_b1")

		game.restartTiming()
		game.setUserInputEnabled(true)
		role.setIdleActionEnabled(true)
		isPlayingDemo = false

		isSkip = false
	until true
end

if isSkip then
	camera.gotoRole()
	camera.setFollowRoleMode(true)
	dialog.setSkipEnabled(false)
	game.resumeLogic()
	game.showTutorialDiagram(0)
	game.setUserInputEnabled(true)
	role.setIdleActionEnabled(true)
	game.restartTiming()
end
